description: Estimated driving range declined versus the vehicle's recent baseline.
recommended_next_step: Compare HVAC load, stop-and-go speed, trip length, tire pressure, and energy consumption; verify with vehicle-specific baselines.

description: Battery temperature crossed the demo alert threshold during a delivery run.
recommended_next_step: Treat as a simulated warning. Review thermal-management telemetry and follow the manufacturer's service procedure; do not infer a failed component from this record alone.

description: Lane-assistance system disengaged after lane markings became difficult to detect.
recommended_next_step: Show the event in the timeline and ask the driver to remain attentive. This is an ADAS assist event, not autonomous-driving evidence.

description: Driver-assistance feature temporarily disengaged in simulated heavy-rain conditions.
recommended_next_step: Display conditions and event time; do not claim that weather was the sole cause without supporting sensor evidence.

description: Forward-camera perception confidence dropped in simulated low-angle glare.
recommended_next_step: Present the confidence/event timeline and advise the user to follow the vehicle manual.

description: Lane-assistance disengagement recorded in a simulated construction zone.
recommended_next_step: Show the last events and contextual signals; do not automatically take control of vehicle functions.

description: Right-front tire pressure fell below the dataset's illustrative threshold.
recommended_next_step: Flag for inspection and compare all tire readings. Threshold is illustrative; follow the manufacturer's recommended pressure.

description: AC charging session began at the depot/home location.
recommended_next_step: Record charging start/end and SOC delta for range and energy summaries.

description: AC charging session ended after the target SOC was reached.
recommended_next_step: Calculate delivered energy only when meter data is available; SOC delta is an estimate.

description: Inverter-cooling performance flag recorded in the simulated diagnostic stream.
recommended_next_step: Treat the code as synthetic. Keep a diagnostic snapshot and request qualified inspection rather than prescribing a repair.

description: High cabin cooling load coincided with repeated low-speed driving.
recommended_next_step: Compare to similar routes and weather before estimating the contribution of HVAC or traffic.

description: Tire-pressure monitor signal was intermittently unavailable in this simulated run.
recommended_next_step: Separate sensor availability issues from actual low-pressure readings.
